:::{#exm-aft-quantiles}
#### Median event times with an acceleration factor of 4

In @exm-aft, the baseline survival function is $\surv_0(t) = \expf{-t/40}$.
Its median ($q = 0.5$) solves $\surv_0(t_{0.5}^0) = 0.5$:

$$
\ba
\expf{-t_{0.5}^0 / 40} &= 0.5
&& \text{(definition of the median)} \\
-t_{0.5}^0 / 40 &= \logf{0.5}
&& \text{(take logs)} \\
t_{0.5}^0 &= -40 \logf{0.5}
&& \text{(multiply by } -40 \text{)} \\
&= 40 \logf{2}
&& \text{(} -\logf{0.5} = \logf{1/0.5} = \logf{2} \text{)} \\
&\approx 27.73
&& \text{(evaluate)}
\ea
$$

By @thm-aft-quantiles, with $\hazfactor(\vx) = 4$,
the median for covariate pattern $\vx$ is
$27.73 / 4 \approx 6.93$ weeks.
To check:
$\surv(6.93 \mid \vx) = \surv_0(6.93 \cdot 4) = \surv_0(27.73) = 0.5$.

:::
